reviews.title: Please Add Index Holdings Sorted by Weightage or Market Cap
reviews.text: The application is very user-friendly! I would like to suggest a useful feature: when users open any stock market index, such as Nifty 50 or Sensex, please display its constituent stocks sorted by index weightage or market capitalization. It would be very helpful to have an option to sort the holdings by either index weightage (%) or market capitalization, so users can easily identify the stocks that have the biggest influence on the index. This feature would make it much easier for investors to understand index composition and analyze the market. I hope the Groww team considers adding this feature in a future update. Thank you for building such a great app!

reviews.title: One of the most pathetic experiences I have ever had with a financial platform.
reviews.text: Groww looks impressive until you actually need help. The moment there is a serious issue involving your money, the so-called “customer support” becomes an endless cycle of useless automated replies, copy-pasted messages and absolutely zero accountability. It is honestly frustrating to see a financial platform put so much effort into making the app look smooth while seemingly putting so little effort into actually helping customers when something goes wrong. You don’t feel like a customer—you feel like a ticket number being passed around by a system that doesn’t care whether your problem gets resolved or not. When money is involved, “please wait” and generic replies are NOT customer service. The entire experience has been unbelievably frustrating, time-consuming and disappointing. If you expect quick resolution, proper communication and someone to actually take ownership of your issue, don’t expect much from Groww. I seriously regret choosing this platform. A financial service should give customers confidence and peace of mind—not make them constantly worry about whether their issue will ever be resolved. Groww needs a reality check. A good-looking app cannot compensate for terrible support and a frustrating customer experience. I would not recommend Groww based on my experience. There are better alternatives where customers deserve to be treated like customers.

reviews.text: I am facing serious issues while trading on the Groww platform. Whenever I place an order at the price currently displayed on the app, or set a specific price at which I want to buy or sell, my order is often not executed at the expected price or within the expected time. I am also experiencing problems with stop-loss orders. Even after setting a specific stop-loss level, my position sometimes gets executed at a different price, resulting in a higher loss than I expected. There also appears to be a delay in order execution. Even when the market reaches the price at which my order should be triggered, the order is not always executed immediately. This has caused me financial losses on multiple occasions. I request you to investigate the following: 1. Why are my orders not being executed promptly when the market reaches my specified price? 2. Why are my stop-loss orders sometimes executed at a price different from the stop-loss level I set? 3. Is there any execution delay, slippage, liquidity issue, or other technical reason responsible for these differences? 4. Please provide the complete order execution details for the affected trades, including the order placement time, trigger time, execution time, requested price, and actual executed price. I request a proper investigation and a clear explanation regarding these issues, as they are directly affecting my trades and causing financial losses. Please resolve this issue at the earliest.
